title: Distribution of 400 Educational Apps - 4
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Airport facilitated the distribution of educational apps for Class 10 SSC Board students to support their learning and examination preparation.
description: Rotary Club of Bombay Airport facilitated the distribution of educational apps for Class 10 SSC Board students to support their learning and examination preparation. Two schools in Nerul were included in the initiative. Representatives from IDEAL STUDY APP, Ms Vandana and Mr Amole, explained the app's content to students and teachers and demonstrated its features. Demo links were shared with the school principals to help assess the app's usefulness. PP Ujwal Andhari sponsored 200 apps, while Rtn Sitaram Churiwala sponsored the remaining 200. PP Ashmi Parekh facilitated the project.
